question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
WITH 
-- Product pages (exclude page_ids 1, 2, 12, 13)
product_pages AS (
    SELECT page_id, page_name, product_id, product_category
    FROM shopping_cart_page_hierarchy
    WHERE product_id IS NOT NULL
),
-- Purchase visits (visits that have a Purchase event on page 13)
purchase_visits AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT visit_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events
    WHERE event_type = 3 AND page_id = 13
),
-- Products added to cart in purchase visits (these are the purchased products)
purchased_items AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.visit_id, p.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN product_pages p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
      AND e.visit_id IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchase_visits)
),
-- All add-to-cart events on product pages
add_to_cart_events AS (
    SELECT e.visit_id, p.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN product_pages p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 2
),
-- All page view events on product pages
view_events AS (
    SELECT e.visit_id, p.product_id
    FROM shopping_cart_events e
    JOIN product_pages p ON e.page_id = p.page_id
    WHERE e.event_type = 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(pp.product_id AS INTEGER) AS product_id,
    pp.page_name AS product_name,
    pp.product_category,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM view_events ve WHERE ve.product_id = pp.product_id) AS view_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM add_to_cart_events ac WHERE ac.product_id = pp.product_id) AS add_to_cart_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ac.visit_id) 
     FROM add_to_cart_events ac 
     WHERE ac.product_id = pp.product_id 
       AND ac.visit_id NOT IN (SELECT visit_id FROM purchased_items pi WHERE pi.product_id = pp.product_id)
    ) AS left_in_cart_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pi.visit_id) 
     FROM purchased_items pi 
     WHERE pi.product_id = pp.product_id
    ) AS purchase_count
FROM product_pages pp
ORDER BY product_id
